notes.title: Cymut X Mutrobo - The Last Cymut. Update 05/29/2024.
notes.notes:
Cymut X Mutrobo - The Last Cymut.

Update 05/29/2024.
1 - Objective icons now have distance information.
2 - Mutrobo health was reduced by 30%.
3 - Boss health decreased from 80 to 70.
4 - Mutrobo's normal attacks are now on the entire body.
5 - Some audios were added to the Mutrobos.
6 - Error in weather audio corrected.
7 - Additions to camera positioning for better viewing.
8 - Addition of the Vietnamese language.
9 - Addition of the Philipine Language.
10 - Addition of the Polish language.
11 - Addition of the Ukrainian language.
